meta.title: Room Layout 3D · AI Data Center
meta.description: Interactive 3D AI data center layout covering the campus, four-level building, and detailed data floor.

campus.title: AIDC Campus Overview
campus.description: Drag to orbit the campus, then select the highlighted A02 data center building.
campus.info: A02 is the campus compute core, supported by a dedicated substation, transformer yard and diesel generator plant for utility and standby power.

building.title: A02 · Four-Level Data Center
building.description: The building contains data floors 1F, 2F and 3F plus the RF equipment level. Select a data floor for details.
building.info: 1F–2F is 8.0m high; 2F–3F and 3F–RF are 7.0m each. Cool gray marks data halls, cyan-blue marks cooling, amber marks power, and green marks rooftop battery zones. This is a functional cutaway.

floor.title: A02 · {floor} Detailed Data Floor
floor.description: Drag to inspect raised functional zones, contained aisles, overhead services and rack arrays. Every floor uses the same standardized POD modules.
floor.info: Each floor is about 133m × 92m. EHU rooms use AHU-style casing, filters, coils, fans and supply ducts; hydraulic modules show pumps, heat exchangers, supply/return headers and valves. Capacity remains 1,280 racks.

fallback.title: 3D rendering is unavailable in this browser
fallback.body: Enable hardware acceleration or use the latest Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
